value_stream.name: Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) & Integrated Business Planning

fields.Participants: Supply Planning (links to VS-02), S&OP Lead, Logistics/DC (links to VS-04/VS-06), Sourcing/Vendor (links to VS-03/VS-122), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Commodity (links to VS-106)
fields.Volume: Supply plan across 4 DCs, ~800–1,000 vendors, 2–3x weekly replenishment

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-translate of "translate the consensus demand into a supply plan" drafts (replaces manual Step 1 builds).
- System auto-import of "Supply Planning identify supply constraints" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "document supply options to close gaps" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-611 (ensure controlled execution — Supply Reconciliation, Pre-S&OP & Scenario Planning (PA-127.2).)
- operational: explicit supply review; operational: long-horizon planning
Pain Points / Risks: - **Capacity-blind risk**: Demand plan ignores vendor/DC/transport capacity limits; mitigated by explicit supply review
- **Import-lead-time risk**: 45–90 day import lead means today's decision affects supply months out (links to VS-122); mitigated by long-horizon planning
System Touchpoints: - Supply planning (links to VS-02); procurement/vendor (links to VS-03); sourcing/import (links to VS-122); DC (links to VS-04); logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110); commodity (links to VS-106); DG transport (links to VS-114)

steps.activity: Supply Planning translate the consensus demand (links to W3907) into a supply plan: vendor capacity, PO/release schedule (links to VS-03/VS-02), import-container plan (links to VS-122/VS-02.2), DC throughput capacity (links to VS-04), and transportation capacity (links to VS-06/VS-110)

Supply Planning identify supply constraints (vendor capacity limits, MOQ, import lead times 45–90 days links to VS-122, DC/transport capacity, commodity availability links to VS-106, DG/hazmat transport links to VS-114) and quantify the gap to demand
Supply Planning document supply options to close gaps (alternate vendors links to VS-03/VS-122, expedites, capacity expansion, substitution) and feed pre-S&OP (links to W3916)

fields.Participants: Supply Planning (links to VS-02), Inventory (links to VS-05), S&OP Lead, DC (links to VS-04), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Logistics (links to VS-06)
fields.Volume: Inventory plan across 200 stores + 4 DCs; ~6–8x turn target

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-set of inventory targets by SKU class per the profile §6.6 A/B/C policy (replaces manual Step 1 reviews).
- System auto-identify of "identify inventory risks" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - operational: turn/WOS targets; operational: safety-stock policy and sensing (links to W3910)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Overstock risk**: Plan builds inventory beyond turn/service need, tying up working capital; mitigated by turn/WOS targets
- **Stockout risk**: Under-plan causes A-item stockouts and lost sales; mitigated by safety-stock policy and sensing (links to W3910)
System Touchpoints: - Inventory (links to VS-05); supply (links to VS-02); DC (links to VS-04); store ops (links to VS-07); seasonal clearance (links to VS-64); obsolete (links to VS-05.3); markdown (links to VS-101); finance (links to VS-17.4)

steps.activity: Supply Planning/Inventory set inventory targets by SKU/class (ROP/safety stock links to profile §6.6, A/B/C policy), reconcile projected inventory position (on-hand + in-transit + PO vs demand), and project weeks-of-supply and turn by category/region

Supply Planning identify inventory risks (overstock slow-movers links to VS-64/VS-05.3, stockout A-items, obsolete links to VS-05.3, stranded/damaged links to VS-90) and corrective actions (rebalancing transfers links to profile §7.4, markdown links to VS-101/VS-64, expedites)
Supply Planning align the replenishment plan (2–3x weekly per store links to profile §7.2) and cycle/seasonal build to the consensus plan, and feed pre-S&OP (links to W3916)

fields.Participants: Sourcing (links to VS-122), Import/Customs (links to VS-87/VS-02.2), Supply Planning (links to VS-02), Vendor Mgmt (links to VS-03), Logistics/Freight (links to VS-110/VS-06), Finance/SCF (links to VS-105), Commodity (links to VS-106), DG (links to VS-114)
fields.Volume: ~400–600 import TEUs/month; ~400 international vendors; ~PHP 1.4B/month import value

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-import of "import plan from the consensus demand" (replaces manual Step 1).
Controls: - CTL-611 (ensure controlled execution — Supply Reconciliation, Pre-S&OP & Scenario Planning (PA-127.2).)
- operational: long-horizon sensing and safety stock; operational: buffer and freight visibility (links to VS-110/VS-87)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Lead-time-compounding risk**: Demand errors compound over 45–90 day import lead (links to VS-122); mitigated by long-horizon sensing and safety stock
- **Port/customs risk**: PH port congestion/customs delay disrupts supply; mitigated by buffer and freight visibility (links to VS-110/VS-87)
System Touchpoints: - Sourcing/import (links to VS-122); customs (links to VS-87); freight (links to VS-110); supply (links to VS-02); commodity (links to VS-106); DG (links to VS-114); treasury/SCF (links to VS-18/VS-105); ABC (links to VS-86)

steps.activity: Sourcing/Supply size the import plan from the consensus demand (links to W3907): container forecast (TEUs), vendor allocation, consolidated-container buying (links to VS-122), and the 45–90-day lead-time phasing (order → produce → ship → customs → DC)

Sourcing/Import manage lead-time and supply risk: vendor capacity, ocean freight (links to VS-110), customs/compliance (links to VS-87), port congestion, DG/hazmat (links to VS-114), commodity availability (links to VS-106), and sourcing-agent performance (links to VS-122)

Sourcing/Finance align import financing (LC/TT links to VS-18, SCF links to VS-105), and import-vendor trade-compliance/ABC gating (links to VS-86/VS-122), and feed import constraints to pre-S&OP (links to W3916)

fields.Participants: S&OP Lead, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Merchandising (links to VS-01), Finance (links to VS-17.4/VS-101), Marketing (links to VS-14), Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110), Sourcing (links to VS-122), Store Ops (links to VS-07)
fields.Trigger: Demand + supply reviews complete (links to W3907/W3913)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-reconcile of "S&OP Lead reconcile demand" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-import of "import capacity → accept stockout vs expedite vs substitute" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-generate of "prepare the executive S&OP pack" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: structured issue log and exec escalation; operational: pre-S&OP preparation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Bury-the-issue risk**: Issues smoothed over rather than escalated; mitigated by structured issue log and exec escalation
- **Late-surprise risk**: New issue emerges at exec S&OP without options; mitigated by pre-S&OP preparation
System Touchpoints: - S&OP platform; demand/supply/inventory plans; finance (links to VS-101/VS-17.4); scenario (links to W3917); exec pack

steps.activity: S&OP Lead reconcile demand (links to W3907) vs supply (links to W3913) vs inventory (links to W3914) vs financial targets (links to W3912), and identify the constrained plan and unresolved issues
S&OP Lead develop the issue list with options, owners, and financial/service impact (e.g., demand exceeds import capacity → accept stockout vs expedite vs substitute), and pre-align key stakeholders
S&OP Lead prepare the executive S&OP pack (plan summary, KPIs links to W3925, scenarios links to W3917, decisions needed) and escalate unresolved items to exec S&OP (links to W3919)

fields.Participants: S&OP Lead, Demand Planning, Supply (links to VS-02), Finance (links to VS-17.4/VS-101), Strategy (links to VS-33), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Sourcing (links to VS-122), Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-model of "model scenarios" demand/supply what-ifs (replaces manual Step 1 spreadsheets).
- System auto-identify of "identify mitigation per scenario" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-611 (ensure controlled execution — Supply Reconciliation, Pre-S&OP & Scenario Planning (PA-127.2).)
- operational: decision-focused scenario framing; operational: Finance/Supply validation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Analysis-paralysis risk**: Too many scenarios without decision; mitigated by decision-focused scenario framing
- **Model-credibility risk**: Scenarios built on unrealistic assumptions; mitigated by Finance/Supply validation
System Touchpoints: - S&OP/what-if platform; finance (links to VS-101/VS-105); commodity (links to VS-106); FX (links to VS-18.3); typhoon (links to VS-69); sourcing (links to VS-122)

steps.activity: S&OP/Demand model scenarios: demand up/down (typhoon spike links to VS-69, promo over/under links to W3909, key-account win links to VS-107), supply disruption (vendor failure links to VS-03, port/customs links to VS-87/VS-110), commodity spike (links to VS-106), and FX (links to VS-18.3)
S&OP/Finance quantify scenario financial/service/inventory impact (revenue/margin/turn/working-capital links to VS-101/VS-105), and identify mitigation per scenario
S&OP Lead present decision-relevant scenarios to exec S&OP (links to W3919) with recommended action and risk

fields.Participants: S&OP Lead, Supply (links to VS-02), Logistics/DC (links to VS-04/VS-06/VS-110), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Sourcing (links to VS-03/VS-122), HR/WFM (links to VS-19.3), Treasury (links to VS-18/VS-105)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-import of "S&OP/Supply run rough-cut capacity planning" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "check financial constraints" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-flag of "flag capacity/financial constraints that bind the plan and require exec decision" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-611 (ensure controlled execution — Supply Reconciliation, Pre-S&OP & Scenario Planning (PA-127.2).)
- operational: RCCP and phasing; operational: financial constraint check
Pain Points / Risks: - **Capacity-binding risk**: Plan exceeds DC/store/vendor capacity in peak (ber-months); mitigated by RCCP and phasing
- **Capital-binding risk**: Plan requires more working capital/capex than available (links to VS-18/VS-105); mitigated by financial constraint check
System Touchpoints: - DC (links to VS-04); store labor/WFM (links to VS-19.3); transport (links to VS-06/VS-110); vendor (links to VS-03/VS-122); capex (links to VS-40/VS-112); working capital (links to VS-105); treasury (links to VS-18)

steps.activity: S&OP/Supply run rough-cut capacity planning: DC throughput (links to VS-04), store labor for peak (links to VS-19.3/VS-07), transport capacity (links to VS-06/VS-110), vendor capacity (links to VS-03/VS-122), and import-container flow (links to VS-122) against the plan

S&OP/Finance check financial constraints: capex for capacity (links to VS-40/VS-112), working-capital/inventory investment (links to VS-105), cash/credit (links to VS-18), and margin impact (links to VS-101)
S&OP Lead flag capacity/financial constraints that bind the plan and require exec decision (expand capacity, phase growth, adjust targets — links to W3919)

fields.Participants: COO (chair), S&OP Lead, VP Merchandising (links to VS-01), CFO/FP&A (links to VS-17.4/VS-101), CMO (links to VS-14), VP Supply Chain/Logistics (links to VS-02/VS-06), Head of Trade / Account Management/Trade (links to VS-11/VS-107), Strategy (links to VS-33), Sourcing (links to VS-122)

Automation Opportunity: - System rule-based auto-approval of "approve the single agreed constrained plan for the horizon" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "document decisions, owners, and follow-ups, and cascade the approved plan for…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-611 (ensure controlled execution — Supply Reconciliation, Pre-S&OP & Scenario Planning (PA-127.2).)
- operational: decision-forcing pack and monthly cadence; operational: agenda discipline (forward-looking only)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Decision-deferral risk**: Executives defer decisions, locking in a suboptimal plan; mitigated by decision-forcing pack and monthly cadence
- **Scope-creep risk**: Meeting drifts into operational fire-fighting; mitigated by agenda discipline (forward-looking only)
System Touchpoints: - S&OP platform/decision log; KPI scorecard (links to W3925); finance (links to VS-101/VS-17.4); strategy (links to VS-33)

steps.activity: S&OP Lead present the monthly plan, KPI scorecard (links to W3925), scenario options (links to W3917), and the decision list (gap-to-target links to W3912, capacity/financial constraints links to W3918, supply risks links to W3913/W3915)
Executives debate, decide on unresolved issues (accept gap / invest / substitute / phase / adjust target), and approve the single agreed constrained plan for the horizon
S&OP Lead document decisions, owners, and follow-ups, and cascade the approved plan for publication (links to W3920) and cross-function alignment

fields.Participants: S&OP Lead, Supply (links to VS-02), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Finance (links to VS-101/VS-17.4), Marketing (links to VS-14), Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110), Sourcing (links to VS-122/VS-03), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Trade (links to VS-11/VS-107)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-translate of "translate the consensus demand into a supply plan" drafts (replaces manual Step 1 builds).
- System auto-distribute of "consume the plan into their operational cycles" to Logistics/DC owners (replaces manual Step 2 publishing).
- System auto-track of "tracking into the next cycle" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-611 (ensure controlled execution — Supply Reconciliation, Pre-S&OP & Scenario Planning (PA-127.2).)
- operational: plan-adherence KPI (links to W3925/W3926); operational: change discipline
Pain Points / Risks: - **Plan-execution-gap risk**: Published plan not followed by functions; mitigated by plan-adherence KPI (links to W3925/W3926)
- **Plan-volatility risk**: Large month-to-month swings destabilize execution; mitigated by change discipline
System Touchpoints: - S&OP platform; supply/PO (links to VS-02/VS-03); import (links to VS-122); promo (links to VS-14/VS-58); finance (links to VS-101/VS-17.4); logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110)

steps.activity: S&OP Lead publish the approved constrained plan (volume/margin by category/region/SKU-family over the horizon) as the single source for execution: PO/release schedule (links to VS-02/VS-03), import plan (links to VS-122), replenishment (links to VS-02), promo/marketing plan (links to VS-14/VS-58), and financial plan alignment (links to VS-101)

Functions consume the plan into their operational cycles: Supply → PO/releases (links to VS-02/VS-03/VS-122), Merchandising → markdown/assortment (links to VS-01/VS-101), Marketing → promo execution (links to VS-14/VS-58), Finance → reforecast/budget (links to VS-17.4/VS-101), Logistics → capacity (links to VS-06/VS-110)
S&OP Lead communicate plan changes vs prior month (delta and rationale) and ensure execution alignment, with adherence tracking into the next cycle (links to W3926)
